behind_the_code.subheading: STUDENT · WEB DEV · AI DEV · CURIOUS MIND
description: I’m a student, web developer and digital creator who enjoys turning ideas into working experiments. My interests span AI, programming, education technology, scientific exploration, creative coding, and interactive experiences. I learn by building—exploring new technologies, testing unconventional ideas, and creating tools that make complex concepts more engaging, useful, and easier to understand.

I love building things that seem unrealistic, difficult, or simply too ambitious at first. I enjoy pushing myself to make both the code and UI/UX as polished as possible. Beyond coding, I love reading, watching films, writing poems and blogs, playing chess, drawing, crafting digital art, and graphic designing. I’m also deeply curious about the rapidly evolving world of AI.
